metadata.wave_focus: all wetting agents (Aqua Aid + Syngenta + Stamina) — final wave

granular.name: Andersons 13-1-10 + 2% Fe and micros
granular.notes: 100% ammonium sulphate N. Acidifying — reduces black layer. 18% S boosts N uptake efficiency. SGN 100 fine prill.
granular.useCase: Spring greens acidifier. Black layer mitigation. Cool-season N when slow-release ineffective.
granular.nFormReason: 100% ammonium sulphate confirmed per PGG product description. Low volatilisation risk. Acidifying soil-N pathway.

granular.name: Andersons 21-1-13 + 1% Fe and micros
granular.notes: 97% MUtech methylene urea — up to 3-month consistent release. Low burn potential. SGN 100 fine prill.
granular.useCase: Greens maintenance. Best in warm conditions (>15C soil). Programmatic feeding.
granular.nFormReason: 97% methylene urea (MUtech) slow-release. MU requires microbial breakdown — temperature-dependent (>15C optimal). Low volatilisation.

granular.name: Andersons A-Tep Micronutrients
granular.notes: Secondary + micronutrient supplement (no NPK). 12% Mg, 8% Fe, 3% Mn, 1% Zn, 0.5% Cu. SGN 100 fine prill.
granular.useCase: Micronutrient correction. Construction-phase blend. Stress/disease tolerance support.
granular.nFormReason: Zero declared N. No volatilisation pathway.

granular.name: Andersons Nutri DG 12-1-10
granular.notes: Nutri DG dispersing granule (0.75mm). 100% ammonium sulphate N. Proactin bio-enhancement (amino acids, vitamins). No mower pickup.
granular.useCase: Premium greens spoonfeeding. Bio-enhanced colour + stress support. Quick N response.
granular.nFormReason: 100% sulphate of ammonia confirmed per PGG description. Bio-enhanced with proactin (amino acid/vitamin matrix) — no impact on N classification. Low volatilisation.

granular.name: Andersons Nutri DG 17-0-14
granular.notes: Nutri DG (0.75mm). 50% slow-release MUtech + 50% upfront ammonium sulphate. NK no P, no Fe. Balanced upfront/slow blend.
granular.useCase: Greens maintenance with balanced N timing. Mid-season feeding. K builder.
granular.nFormReason: 50/50 MUtech (methylene urea) + ammonium sulphate per PGG description. Mixed release with low volatilisation pathways (MU stabilised, AS acidifying).

granular.name: Andersons Nutri DG 18-1-15
granular.notes: Nutri DG (0.75mm). 93% MUtech methylene urea. Summer/warm-season formula. Balanced NPK with trace P.
granular.useCase: Warm-season greens (>15C soil). Sustained N release. Summer programmatic feeding.
granular.nFormReason: 93% methylene urea (MUtech) confirmed per PGG description. Microbial breakdown required — temperature-dependent. Low volatilisation.

granular.name: Andersons Starter 19-11-4 + 1% Fe & micros
granular.notes: 18% MUtech slow-release N + 82% upfront. High P (11%) for root establishment. Fine SGN 100 — fills grooves, plugs, core holes.
granular.useCase: New seeding starter. Renovation. Core hole fill. Root development.
granular.nFormReason: 18% MUtech + 82% remaining N (likely urea/AS blend per Andersons starter formulations). Mixed release. Low-moderate volatilisation in cool conditions.

granular.name: DuraTurf Amino Fertiliser 13-2-6
granular.notes: PGG own-brand DuraTurf blend. Quick-release NPK + amino acids + humic acids. Reduced leaching. Cost-effective maintenance.
granular.useCase: Outfield maintenance / base fertiliser. Sportsfield programmatic feeding. Cost-conscious tee feeding.
granular.nFormReason: PGG description does not declare N source split. Likely urea + AS blend per typical NZ blended NPK products. SDS check needed.

granular.name: Andersons 28-1-8 50%
granular.notes: 50% NS-54 PCSCU (polymer + sulphur coated urea). Early-season option. Excellent ballistics. Low burn potential.
granular.useCase: Spring outfield / fairway PCSCU release. Economical sustained N. Sportsfield base.
granular.nFormReason: 50% NS-54 PCSCU coated-urea + 50% upfront. Polymer + sulphur coating stabilises urea against volatilisation. Temperature-dependent release.

granular.name: Andersons 32-1-8 + 2% Fe
granular.notes: 30% NS-54 PCSCU + 70% upfront. 2.40 mm uniform particles. 2% Fe for immediate colour response. Complete early-season fertiliser.
granular.useCase: High-N spring outfield. Fairway colour boost. Sportsfield kick-start.
granular.nFormReason: 30% NS-54 PCSCU + 70% upfront (likely urea). Mixed quick + slow release. Coating reduces volatilisation on coated fraction; upfront fraction at risk in warm/dry conditions.

granular.name: Andersons Nutri DG 20-0-13
granular.notes: Nutri DG (0.75mm). 100% MUtech-M longer chain methylene urea (very slow release). No P. Summer formula. NK ratio favours K.
granular.useCase: Summer programmatic N. Warm-season sustained feeding. No P needed (high-P sites).
granular.nFormReason: 100% MUtech-M (longer-chain methylene urea: DMTU, TMTU, TMPU). Microbial breakdown required — strongly temperature-dependent (>18C optimal). Very low volatilisation.

granular.name: Andersons Ornamental/Garden 18-3-10
granular.notes: 83% MUtech-XL very slow release N — 8-9 months season-long feeding. Cost-effective ornamental/landscape formula.
granular.useCase: Once-per-season landscape feeding. Long-duration ornamental beds. Low-maintenance areas.
granular.nFormReason: 83% MUtech-XL (very-slow methylene urea, extended-chain). 17% remaining N likely upfront urea. Strongly temperature-dependent (>18C optimal).

granular.name: Andersons Pendi Pro 22-0-5
granular.notes: FERTILISER + HERBICIDE COMBO. 7.5 g/kg pendimethalin pre-emergent (summergrass, crowsfoot, Poa annua). 40% PCSCU. Sulphur included.
granular.useCase: Late-winter/early-spring pre-emergent program. Annual grass weed prevention + N feeding. Avoid newly-seeded areas.
granular.nFormReason: 40% PCSCU coated urea + 60% upfront (likely urea/AS). Note: contains 7.5 g/kg pendimethalin AI — engine should not route this for greens or new seeding.

granular.name: Ammonium Sulphate 20.5-0-0 + 24% S (granular)
granular.notes: Agricultural grade prill. Acidifying broad-acre N. Should be watered in after application. 24% S for N uptake efficiency.
granular.useCase: Broad-acre acidifying N. High-pH soil correction. Sportsfield base N. Watering essential.
granular.nFormReason: 100% ammonium sulphate. Acidifying. Low volatilisation when watered in.

granular.name: Di-Ammonium Phosphate (DAP) 18-20-0
granular.notes: Agricultural grade establishment fertiliser. Soil-incorporate prior to sowing. High N + P starter blend.
granular.useCase: Establishment / renovation P. Pre-seed incorporation. Budget starter fertiliser.
granular.nFormReason: Di-ammonium phosphate — N is in ammoniacal form. Acidifying. Low volatilisation when incorporated.

granular.name: PGW Outfields Mix 12-5-15 + Trace Elements
granular.notes: Heat-treated homogenous prill (not granule blend). SOP rather than MOP — chloride-free. Ammonium N gives some extended turf nutrition.
granular.useCase: Cost-effective outfield NPK + trace elements. Sports field maintenance. Park turf.
granular.nFormReason: PGG description specifies ammonium N type. N source declared as "ammonium" giving extended release vs urea. SDS check needed for exact N split.

granular.name: PGW Sports Mix 13.2-2-16.7 + 1% Fe
granular.notes: Two N forms — some delayed release (not slow-release). Excellent N:K ratio. Competitively priced budget outfield product.
granular.useCase: Early-season sportsfield / fairway N+K post-winter. Schools / community fields. Budget option.
granular.nFormReason: PGG description states "two forms of nitrogen" with some delayed release. Likely urea + ammonium sulphate blend. SDS check needed for exact split.

granular.name: Andersons Humic DG
granular.notes: 70% humic acid + 10% humic precursor (from leonardite). Dispersing granule (0.75mm). Chelator + microbial stimulator.
granular.useCase: Soil structure improvement. Enhance nutrient uptake. Sand profile CEC building. Apply alongside NPK fertilisers.
granular.nFormReason: Zero declared N. Pure humic amendment. No volatilisation pathway.

granular.name: Bioboost 6-2-0 + Trace Elements
granular.notes: Organic non-burning slow-release. 12% water-soluble N + 88% microbial conversion. 70% organic matter. NZ Health Department compliant.
granular.useCase: Organic / low-input programs. Soil conditioning. Weed-free organic option. Pre-seed soil prep.
granular.nFormReason: 88% organic N requires microbial conversion (very slow release, 6-9 months). 12% water-soluble fraction immediately plant-available. Volatilisation low (organic-bound).

granular.name: Regen-R-8 7-3-5
granular.notes: Mini prill (SGN 100) for renovation. Contains gypsum (sodic/saline remediation) + Sand-Aid granular seaplant meal. Builds CEC in sand profiles.
granular.useCase: Post-renovation recovery. Sand greens CEC builder. Salt remediation. Core hole fill.
granular.nFormReason: N source not declared on PGG page. Likely organic + ammonium blend given Sand-Aid (seaplant) component. SDS check needed.

granular.name: Rooster Booster 4-2.5-2
granular.notes: Organic pelletised chicken manure. Slow release via microbial conversion. Promotes root growth + CEC correction.
granular.useCase: Organic feeding programs. Soil microbiome support. Poor-CEC soil remediation.
granular.nFormReason: Organic N (chicken manure-derived) requires microbial breakdown. Very slow release. Low volatilisation when incorporated.

granular.name: Tea Seed Pellets
granular.notes: Camellia seed meal pellets. Organic matter amendment. No NPK declared on PGG page — primarily a soil conditioner. Reported earthworm-control side effect (saponins).
granular.useCase: Soil OM improvement. Organic-program amendment. Earthworm castings management on greens (saponin natural mode).
granular.nFormReason: NPK not declared on PGG page. Typically tea seed meal contains ~1% organic N. SDS check needed for declared N if any.

granular.name: Sulphate of Ammonia (soluble grade)
granular.notes: Soluble grade for fertigation / spray tank. Dissolve in 400-600 L water/ha. Acidifying. Bypass slow-release for quick green-up.
granular.useCase: Greens spoonfeeding. Fairway colour spray. Foliar/root N boost. pH management.
granular.nFormReason: 100% ammonium sulphate. Quick-release N + S. Acidifying. Low volatilisation.

granular.name: Stamina G (granular wetting agent)
granular.notes: Long-term granular surfactant. Higher-cut turf (sportsfields, parks, fairways, racetracks, turf farms). Residual LDS prevention.
granular.useCase: Outfield LDS prevention. Coring window application. High-cut programmes.
granular.nFormReason: Wetting agent, zero declared N.

liquid.name: FoliMAX Cal-Mag
liquid.notes: Liquid Ca + Mg in nitrate form. Ideal Ca:Mg ratio. Rapid sodium displacement from root zone. Soluble nitrate carrier.
liquid.useCase: Sodium flushing. Ca/Mg deficiency correction. Salt-affected sites. Sand greens Ca builder.
liquid.nFormReason: Calcium and magnesium are delivered as nitrate salts (Ca(NO3)2 + Mg(NO3)2 per page). Nitrate-N — no volatilisation, immediate plant availability.

liquid.name: FoliMAX CHARGER
liquid.notes: Macro + minor nutrients + hormone growth promoters (kinetin/IBA per FoliMAX literature). Promotes lateral growth + colour. Recovery / grow-in.
liquid.useCase: Renovation recovery. Grow-in establishment. Warm-season grass winter colour. Damage repair.
liquid.nFormReason: Specific NPK and N source not declared on PGG page. SDS/label check needed. FoliMAX product brochure available but binary-locked.

liquid.name: FoliMAX Iron+
liquid.notes: Economical fast-acting liquid iron. Fe % not declared on PGG page — typical FoliMAX range is 6% Fe. Tank-mix compatible.
liquid.useCase: Fe deficiency correction. Greening without growth surge. Tank-mix additive. Disease tolerance support.
liquid.nFormReason: Zero declared N. Pure Fe foliar.

liquid.name: FoliMAX NFE
liquid.notes: EDTA-chelated Fe + Mn with Ammonium Stabilised N. High-analysis NFE formulation. Improved tank-mix stability.
liquid.useCase: Combined Fe + Mn + N foliar. Colour enhancement. Chlorophyll support.
liquid.nFormReason: PGG page describes "Ammonium Stabilised Nitrogen". Stabilised ammonium — low volatilisation, foliar-active.

liquid.name: FoliMAX N-Forcer-N
liquid.notes: High-analysis liquid N. Dual technology: nitrification inhibitors + SRN-IQ slow-release. Two release mechanisms over extended period.
liquid.useCase: Programme backbone foliar N. Extended-period N delivery. Reduced application frequency.
liquid.nFormReason: PGG page describes "nitrification inhibitors + SRN-IQ" technology. Stabilised N (likely urea base + DCD/NBPT class inhibitor + slow-release fraction). Very low volatilisation.

liquid.name: FoliMAX NRG-NK
liquid.notes: Balanced N+K liquid. 50% SRN-IQ slow release + 50% upfront. K as citrate/carbonate (chloride-free). Iron for green-up.
liquid.useCase: Maintenance programme backbone. Balanced foliar feeding. Chloride-free K input.
liquid.nFormReason: 50% SRN-IQ slow-release + 50% upfront. Mixed N pathway. Slow-release fraction has very low volatilisation.

liquid.name: FoliMAX Phosphite+
liquid.notes: POTASSIUM PHOSPHITE (not phosphate) — mono/di-K salts of phosphorus acid. Vitamin B1. Foliar AND root active. Disease suppression effects.
liquid.useCase: Pythium/Take-All/disease pressure. K deficiency correction. Plant vigour. Root development.
liquid.nFormReason: Zero declared N. P is in phosphite form (not phosphate); not directly nutrient-equivalent to phosphate-P.

liquid.name: FoliMAX Trace+
liquid.notes: Multi-trace element foliar. Nutrex Delivery Technology for plant uptake + internal mobility. Specific TE % not declared.
liquid.useCase: Trace element deficiency correction. Regular foliar additive. Tank-mix booster.

liquid.name: FoliMAX Vigor-K
liquid.notes: High-K (30%) liquid. Chloride-free citrate/carbonate complex. Maximum foliar uptake. Tank-mix flexible.
liquid.useCase: Autumn K hardening / winter prep. Pre-stress conditioning. Chloride-sensitive turf. Tank-mix with N-Forcer-N.

liquid.name: Ferrous Sulphate Heptahydrate
liquid.notes: Free-flowing soluble grade FeSO4.7H2O. Suitable for fertigation. Quick green-up. May stain hard surfaces.
liquid.useCase: Fe deficiency correction. Greens colour boost via fertigation. Moss suppression. Low-cost iron source.
liquid.nFormReason: Zero declared N. Fe sulphate soluble.

liquid.name: Magnesium Sulphate Heptahydrate (Epsom Salts)
liquid.notes: Epsom Salts. Free-flowing soluble grade MgSO4.7H2O. Suitable for fertigation. Quick Mg + S correction.
liquid.useCase: Mg deficiency correction. Sand greens Mg builder. S source. Chlorophyll support.
liquid.nFormReason: Zero declared N. Mg sulphate soluble.

liquid.name: Remediator (Aqua Aid)
liquid.notes: 90% calcium chloride solution. PGG: 10 L = 958 kg dry gypsum Ca equivalent. Sodium displacement + EC reduction + soil structure.
liquid.useCase: Sodic soil remediation. Salt-affected turf. Hard / crusting soil structure. Alternative to gypsum.
liquid.nFormReason: Zero declared N. Pure Ca chloride amendment.

liquid.name: OARS HS (Aqua Aid)
liquid.notes: Organic acid redistribution system (OARS). Removes humic coatings from hydrophobic soil particles. Soil hydrating surfactant.
liquid.useCase: Hydrophobic soil remediation. Drought stress reduction. Consistent moisture in hard-to-wet soils.

liquid.name: Qualibra (Syngenta)
liquid.notes: Non-ionic surfactant blend. 100% wetting agent (no water added). Surface drainage + depth retention dual-action.
liquid.useCase: Preventative or curative dry patch. Healthy root mass retention. Irrigation efficiency.

liquid.name: Stamina 90
liquid.notes: 100% non-ionic residual surfactant. Benchmark residual technology. Sandy and heavier soil profiles. Warm + cool season turf safe.
liquid.useCase: Long-term LDS prevention. Programmatic residual application. All-turf-type safe.

liquid.name: Stamina Balance
liquid.notes: Three-surfactant blend specifically for sand-based root zones. Maximises water usage and availability. Premium soil surfactant.
liquid.useCase: Sand greens / tees moisture management. USGA-spec rootzone. Premium-tier programmes.

liquid.name: Stamina Dewstar
liquid.notes: Organosilicone-based super spreader. Concentrated. Highly effective in suppressing dew formation on turf swards.
liquid.useCase: Dew suppression on greens. Disease pressure reduction (dollar spot, Microdochium). Early-play presentation.

liquid.name: Stamina Express
liquid.notes: Thatch + soil penetrant blend with residual component. Economical for large areas. Irrigation-injectable. Boom-sprayer compatible.
liquid.useCase: Fairway / sportsfield penetrant. Irrigation system injection. Large-area surfactant.

liquid.name: Stamina Fairway
liquid.notes: 100% non-ionic residual surfactant for broadacre. 8-week LDS prevention. Low burn potential.
liquid.useCase: Broadacre fairway / sportsfield LDS programme. 8-week residual cycle.

liquid.name: Stamina Relieve
liquid.notes: Soil-amending polymer. Modifies surface tension of hygroscopic (bound) water. Reduces compaction. Improves infiltration + aeration.
liquid.useCase: Soil-surfactant partner. Compacted soil remediation. Improved infiltration. Tank-mix booster.

liquid.name: Stamina Rescue
liquid.notes: Two-surfactant rescue blend: high surface tension surfactant (rapid wetting) + heavier MW surfactant (rewetting). Curative.
liquid.useCase: Hydrophobic emergency rescue. Hot spot management. Curative LDS treatment.
